answer: Beacon spot-checks stop clone farms. Each epoch a beacon samples one in five identities; each must answer a compute heartbeat in time, proving work at the kernel of its onyx badge, or the deposit freezes. 1,000 clones lock 40,000 units and burn 200x10 = 2,000 per epoch on checks; in 10 epochs: 60,000 against at most 50,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays 40 once, answers a rare heartbeat, and keeps its full share as the river of fakes runs dry.
